parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right handle switch of the faucet, made of stainless steel, cylindrical in shape with a small lever for turning.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the flow of water, typically for hot or cold water depending on installation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left handle switch of the faucet, made of stainless steel, similar in design to the right handle.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the flow of water, typically for the opposite temperature (hot or cold) from the right handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to regulate water flow.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, a curved tubular part made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet body to the sink.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally depending on the faucet design.

parts.name: Frame (Right Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right base frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel, supporting the right handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and connects the handle to the internal valve system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame (Left Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left base frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel, supporting the left handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and connects the handle to the internal valve system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame (Spout Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout base frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel, connecting the spout to the sink surface.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and seals the spout connection to prevent leaks.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed, though the spout above it may swivel.
